scope: standard 14641 quadratic Koszul AS-regular indexed Z-algebras; index-preserving isomorphism

invariant.name: rho
invariant.definition: Rank of the 02|13 flattening of the canonical top Frobenius tensor

branches.coverage: disjoint exhaustive split proved in prop:opposite-rank-split

branches.relative_geometry: closed in the finite Frobenius tensor candidate locus
branches.known_subcase: Quantum polynomial members have rho=6 and exactly two indexed classes, represented by q_ab=1 and q_ab=-1; prop:quantum-opposite-rank
branches.coverage: symmetrizability existence predicate and its negation; cor:symmetric-rank-six

branches.relative_geometry: open in the finite Frobenius tensor candidate locus
branches.nonempty_witness: quantum polynomial sample rho=12; signed seven/nine samples rho=8

branches.predicate: canonical tensor orbit meets Sym^4 V under an identification of all four spaces
branches.parameter_chart: U in Gr(4,Sym^2 V*): four quadrics have no common projective zero
branches.coverage: chart surjects onto this predicate locus
branches.complete_isomorphism: proved for all U: GL4 equivalence of quadric spaces; 33-variable 41-equation criterion, cor:symmetric-chart-isomorphism
branches.normal_forms: complete-intersection chart; no complete residual orbit normalization
branches.membership: three linear symmetrizer spaces contain invertible matrices; degree-four determinant nonidentity test, prop:linear-symmetrization-test

branches.predicate: rho<=6 and canonical tensor orbit does not meet the symmetric locus
branches.coverage: alternatizability predicate and its negation; cor:linear-alternating-test
branches.nonempty_witness: commutative polynomial indexed class, alternating top tensor; proven disjoint from symmetric chart
branches.known_subcase: alternating tensor orbit: exactly the commutative polynomial indexed class

branches.predicate: canonical tensor orbit meets Lambda^4 V
branches.membership: three negative-swap linear spaces contain invertible matrices; cor:linear-alternating-test
branches.normal_forms: one indexed class: commutative polynomial ring

branches.predicate: rho<=6 and neither symmetrizable nor alternatizable
branches.excluded_subfamilies: contains no quantum polynomial indexed class, by quantum rank formula and its two rank-six normal forms; also no member of the full polynomial-derivation Ore chart

limits: Coverage is a partition of already regular objects, not a proof that every tensor candidate is Koszul/AS.
No claim that all integers 3..16 occur, or that a rank is a full isomorphism invariant.
Quantum rank strata and their minimal-rank subcase do not exhaust either global branch.
